question: What knowledge has been attained through the grace of the lord of Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas.
The attainment is attributed to that lord's grace.
The speaker claims knowledge of the determination of Kaula.
inference: By the lord's grace, the speaker has come to know the determination of Kaula.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
